en.html:
岩田"Please use this building."
Ichijou"Eh? This whole place? Just for us?"
岩田"It was a guard post until recently. Rather cramped as living quarters; I am afraid you may find it inconvenient."
Kageaki"It is sufficient. The distance from the other residences is welcome."
岩田"Yes. I selected it with that in mind. Nobody will overhear your conversations here."
岩田"All the same, do not become careless."
Kageaki"Understood. There is one thing—"
岩田"Yes?"
Kageaki"How should we contact you from now on?"
岩田"Ask for Iwata, the staff officialYoryuudo, at the Mandokoro. You are both supposed to be my subordinates, so there is no need to avoid being seen with me."
Kageaki"Understood."
岩田"Anything else?"
Ichijou"Um... one thing..."
岩田"Yes?"
Ichijou"Minato and I staying in one place like this... won't that look odd? For the cover, I mean."
岩田"Not at all. You are entered together: one Arata unit."

岩田"...These quarters are not built as stoutly as the outer walls or the keep. Please refrain from driving your head into the pillars."
Kageaki"You heard the instruction, Ichijou."
Ichijou"B-but—ONE unit!?"
Kageaki"You had not been told?"
Ichijou"Told? Nobody even mentioned it!"
Kageaki"We chose the same surname for our aliases."
Ichijou"I thought that meant two people with the same cover name, not one combined entry!"
Kageaki"Separate entries might mean separate lodgings. That would be inconvenient."
Ichijou"Haan, woh samajh gayi—I understand that! But still!"
Kageaki"Do you object?"
Ichijou"Eh... what?"
Kageaki"To being entered under one cover with me. Do you object?"
Ichijou"N-not... I didn't say..."
Kageaki"I do."

Kageaki"In any case, we shall begin at once."
岩田"What will you do first?"
Kageaki"Gather information. Confirm the fortress's people and facilities with our own eyes and ears."
Kageaki"The plan comes after that."
岩田"Yes. A sensible approach."
Kageaki"First I want to learn what the targettarget is really like. Can you arrange a meeting?"
岩田"That much is simple. I shall arrange for you to call on official business. In the meantime, please take a bath."
Kageaki"I see... someone particularfussy about appearances?"
岩田"Yes. A girl bringing official documents along with a smell of horse dung would probably make him angry."

en.html:
After Ichijou had bathed, I collected the documents from Ms. Iwata and entered Fudaraku Fortress's main enclosure. Nothing remarkable about the documents themselves: a routine report. It did, however, have to be submitted to the administrator for his seal.

An ideal pretext. That agent worked quickly and neatly. We could now meet the shogunate's current administrator—Doushin Yusa, the only Kubo remaining in the fortress—without anything appearing out of place.

書類を受け取って普陀楽城本丸へ入る。
　書類自体は、どうという事もない定期報告書だった。
しかし執政に提出し、捺印を貰う必要がある。

　格好の材料だった。あの工作員の仕事はなかなか手
早くそつがない。
　これで現在の幕府執政――唯一城に残っている公方、
遊佐童心に何の不自然もなく会う事が叶う。

Compared even with the royalty and aristocracy of other nations, they showed little.

Probably because they still regarded their rule over Yamato as an ongoing <ruby>military operation<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>, <ruby>in their own minds<rt>within</rt></ruby>.

The peacetime duty of the wealthy, to supply the masses with <ruby>gossip<rt>gossip</rt></ruby>, could wait until everything was over. Until they had <ruby>become<rt>become</rt></ruby> the sole and absolute rulers of Yamato.

After spilling a great deal of blood. Or while <ruby>continuing to spill it<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>.

...Ichijou and I were here to see that it did not come to that.

であるとの認識が彼らの裡うちにあるからだ。

　平和時の富貴層の義務として、大衆に世間話ゴシップの種を
提供するよう振舞うのは、全てが終わった後……
　大和唯一にして絶対の支配者に成り果おおせた後の事だ
ろう。

　多くの血を流した末に。あるいは流しながら・・・。
　……そうさせぬ為に、俺と一条は此処にいた。
